### 1.3 EM FX basket membership

EM FX pairs available: BRL, CLP, IDR, INR, KRW, MXN, PLN, TRY, TWD, ZAR
Note: TWD (Taiwan) starts 2004-03-24, earlier pairs from 2003-12.

**Structural exclusion disclosure:** Rules 2 (us_exceptionalism_outflow) and 3 (em_rotation_inflow)
require a non-NaN emfx_63d leg (NaN comparisons return False in pandas boolean indexing).
Sessions with NaN emfx_63d: 2352 total (2352 pre-2010, 0 post-2010).
These sessions are structurally ineligible for Rules 2 and 3. Pre-2010 exceptionalism and rotation
base rates therefore reflect periods where the EM FX leg was available, NOT the full pre-2010 era.
This is not calibration error; it is a definitional constraint of the classifier.

### 1.4 Dollar splice disclosure

- DTWEXBGS (FRED broad trade-weighted): from 2006-01-01 onward
- DXY (Yahoo DX-Y.NYB): before 2006-01-01
- Rolling windows that straddle the splice date are NULLED: usd_20d and usd_63d are set to
  NaN for any date where the lookback period includes data from both series. This eliminates
  the phantom +12.8% splice artifact previously present in the Jan-Apr 2006 usd_63d leg.
  Consequence: Rules 2/3/4 that depend on usd_63d cannot fire during the straddle window
  (~63 sessions after 2006-01-01, i.e., through approximately 2006-04).

## §5 — Threshold sensitivity


Recomputed base rates with divergence threshold at 2pp, 3pp (baseline), and 4pp;
and VIX gates at 20, 25 (baseline), and 30.

| Div threshold | VIX gate | % sessions relabeled | risk-off% | exception% | rotation% | goldilocks% | mixed% |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2pp | 20 | 8.3% | 9.2% | 19.4% | 15.1% | 8.2% | 48.1% |
| 2pp | 25 | 7.1% | 7.7% | 20.1% | 15.2% | 8.1% | 48.8% |
| 2pp | 30 | 8.7% | 6.1% | 20.4% | 15.4% | 8.1% | 50.0% |
| 3pp | 20 | 1.6% | 9.4% | 17.0% | 12.9% | 11.7% | 49.0% |
| 3pp | 25 | 0.0% **(baseline)** | 8.0% | 17.5% | 13.0% | 11.6% | 50.0% |
| 3pp | 30 | 1.7% | 6.3% | 17.7% | 13.3% | 11.6% | 51.1% |
| 4pp | 20 | 7.4% | 8.9% | 14.8% | 11.5% | 13.5% | 51.2% |
| 4pp | 25 | 6.1% | 7.6% | 15.2% | 11.7% | 13.3% | 52.3% |
| 4pp | 30 | 7.8% | 5.9% | 15.4% | 11.8% | 13.3% | 53.6% |

**Honest read of lability:** The divergence threshold primarily affects the exceptionalism
and rotation labels. At 2pp, both are more frequent; at 4pp, both contract sharply toward
mixed. The baseline 3pp was frozen before this census (CBF-R3 — no fitting). The VIX gate
mainly affects risk-off labeling: a ±5 point shift changes risk-off incidence noticeably,
suggesting the 25-level is near a cluster of VIX observations. The mixed regime dominates
across all parameter combinations, reflecting genuine ambiguity in price-inferred flow direction.

## §6 — Case-law alignment check


Classifier state for documented historical episodes. Honest misses stated as misses.

### 2013-05..2013-09 — Taper tantrum
**Expected:** exceptionalism/risk-off flavors
**Context:** Fed taper fear; $150B gross EM equity outflows (IMF SDN14/09); Fragile Five currencies -10-20%
**Dominant observed state:** `us_exceptionalism_outflow`
**Full distribution:** `us_exceptionalism_outflow` 89%, `mixed` 10%, `goldilocks_synchronized` 1%

Alignment: consistent.

### 2015-08..2016-02 — CNY devaluation
**Expected:** risk-off/mixed
**Context:** CNY devaluation shock; global risk-off; breadth wide
**Dominant observed state:** `us_exceptionalism_outflow`
**Full distribution:** `us_exceptionalism_outflow` 68%, `risk_off_convergence` 23%, `mixed` 10%

Alignment: miss — classifier dominant state is `us_exceptionalism_outflow`; expected risk-off/mixed.

### 2017-01..2017-12 — Goldilocks year
**Expected:** goldilocks/rotation
**Context:** All 45 OECD economies expanding; DXY -10%; EM strongly outperformed
**Dominant observed state:** `goldilocks_synchronized`
**Full distribution:** `goldilocks_synchronized` 55%, `us_exceptionalism_outflow` 24%, `em_rotation_inflow` 14%, `mixed` 6%

Alignment: consistent.

### 2020-02..2020-04 — COVID risk-off
**Expected:** risk_off_convergence
**Context:** Universal risk-off; USD +22%; VIX >80; EM worst in USD terms
**Dominant observed state:** `risk_off_convergence`
**Full distribution:** `risk_off_convergence` 50%, `us_exceptionalism_outflow` 44%, `mixed` 6%

Alignment: consistent.

### 2020-11..2021-02 — Rotation/goldilocks
**Expected:** em_rotation_inflow/goldilocks
**Context:** Vaccine optimism; dollar weakness; EM inflows; synchronized recovery
**Dominant observed state:** `em_rotation_inflow`
**Full distribution:** `em_rotation_inflow` 79%, `mixed` 21%

Alignment: consistent.

### 2022-01..2022-10 — Exceptionalism/risk-off
**Expected:** us_exceptionalism_outflow/risk_off
**Context:** DXY to 114.78 peak; Fed hikes; EM double pain; stagflation period
**Dominant observed state:** `risk_off_convergence`
**Full distribution:** `risk_off_convergence` 42%, `mixed` 40%, `us_exceptionalism_outflow` 18%

Alignment: consistent.

### 2025-01..2025-06 — EM rotation
**Expected:** em_rotation_inflow
**Context:** MSCI EM +8.9% vs SPX +1.1% (through May); dollar weakening
**Dominant observed state:** `em_rotation_inflow`
**Full distribution:** `em_rotation_inflow` 36%, `mixed` 34%, `us_exceptionalism_outflow` 30%

Alignment: consistent.
